fit.reference_source: USGS Great Channel at Stone Harbor NJ
fit.method: Constant median(Stone Harbor fresh original NAVD88 minus Lewes original NAVD88), fitted on paired accepted high-tide cycles in complete local calendar years 2008–2025 where Stone Harbor reference is at or above 3.44ft NAVD88. No donor threshold.

qualityRules.coverageDateBasis: predicted-high anchor; event count date is actual peak date or documented crest date

freshPrimaryAudit.qualification: completed disjoint predicted-high midpoint windows; at least 90% UTC hourly occupancy; all six central hourly bins; observed maximum at least one hour from each edge
freshPrimaryAudit.sourcePriority: fresh qualified Stone Harbor primary, existing supported official crests and qualified calibrated Lewes gap fills; no sea-level rebasing
